fields.description: Where alerts for this user go. Not a login, and not unique: one person may own several users.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: The control client's own id for this user; Central sends its team id. One user per reference — a second one is what let a budget be doubled by re-provisioning. Blank on a user made by hand.
fields.label: Reference

fields.description: Never charged and never gated: usage is still recorded, with what it would have cost, but Spent and Balance do not move. Off means prepaid — Σ top-ups − Spent at 0 → Credit Exhausted until topped up, shared by every key they hold. Turning it off later starts the user at what they load.
fields.label: Free

fields.description: Σ Grove Credit entries − Spent, written by pricing.settle on every pull, top-up and save. Top up by adding a Grove Credit.
fields.label: Balance (USD)

fields.description: What the user has been charged: priced by the pull from each billed drain, plus any correction from a resolved Credit Discrepancy. Does not move while the user is Free.
fields.label: Spent (USD)

fields.description: Set by settle when the balance is at or below zero and the user is not Free. Pushed to every gateway, which then refuses the user.
fields.label: Credit Exhausted

fields.description: Store this user's prompts and model outputs in the gateway's payload log (short retention, support queries).
fields.label: Log Prompts & Outputs

fields.description: The one geography this user's keys work in; every gateway elsewhere answers 403. Left blank, it is the default Geography. One geography per user keeps all their spend on one store, whose gateway gates it exactly.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: Models this user may never call. Deny wins over everything — a group grant and a Public release both lose to it.
fields.label: Deny

fields.description: Counted on the gateway, per Gateway Store. A window resets on the UTC clock: top of the minute, the hour, midnight, the 1st. No rows = uncapped.
fields.label: Limits
